thread:
Priya: Rapid sync — launching the benchmark blog + webinar next week. Need a tight SEO sprint: keywords, schema, redirects, internal links, and inbound routing for leads. Who picks what?
Leo: I	can take the keyword gaps and metadata. I	want to scope primary/secondary phrases and match them to intent (awareness vs. purchase). Will deliver by tomorrow morning.
Jules: I	own the inbound routing and HubSpot mapping. Will standardize UTMs and ensure the webinar form posts to the right list + workflow. Proposed utm_campaign: benchmark_apr2026.
Toni: Copy will finalize H1/synopsis tonight. Also drafting 2 hero OG images and alt text.
deploy-bot: preview-check: social card rendering failed for /webinar/latency-bench -> 502. @eng please triage.
Priya: Key SEO asks: 1) canonical and pagination rels for the benchmark series; 2) JSON-LD for both the Article and Event; 3) redirect plan for old benchmark drafts; 4) internal links from product docs to benchmark page; 5) ensure CTAs land on tracked HubSpot form.
Leo: Draft JSON-LD snippets (paste):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Article","headline":"Redwood Inference: Latency & Cost Benchmarks","author":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"},"datePublished":"2026-04-13"}
```
and event: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Benchmark webinar","startDate":"2026-04-15T16:00:00-04:00","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/latency-bench"}
```
Use these as base, we'll add image, location, and registrationAction later.
Toni: One small SEO nuance: the old /benchmark/variant-a page has user-marked promos. We should 301 -> new canonical. I'll open MARK-3722.
Jules: UTM plan: utm_source=redwood_newsletter / linkedin / partner; utm_medium=email|social|partner; utm_campaign=benchmark_apr2026; utm_content=creativeA|creativeB. I'll attach the tracking matrix.
Priya: Redirects + nginx example needed for eng:
```nginx
# MARK redirect for old benchmark
rewrite ^/benchmark/variant-a$ /blog/latency-cost-bench permanent;
```
eng, can you confirm this pattern will be fine for 10 legacy URLs?
deploy-bot: deploy-check: staging preview created at https://staging.redwood.ai/webinar/latency-bench-preview (expires in 72h).
Leo: Also recommend adding rel=alternate media for paginated lists and rel=prev/next on the series pages to consolidate signals. I'll include the meta tags in the metadata doc.
Toni: Will send final H1, meta description, and OG title by 18:00 PST. Also recommend we A/B test two meta descriptions focusing on "inference cost" vs "latency tradeoffs".
Priya: Action list (assigning owners):
- Keyword priority + metadata table -> Leo (due: tomorrow am)
- JSON-LD Article + Event -> Leo (due: tomorrow)
- Redirect ticket + 301s -> Toni (MARK-3722) + eng for nginx rules
- UTM naming + HubSpot mapping -> Jules (due: EOD)
- Internal link update (docs -> blog CTAs) -> Toni + Docs owner (Wed)
- Social card & OG preview -> eng + Toni (fix 502)
- Staging crawl + Lighthouse QA -> Priya + Jules (after fixes)

Toni: Created MARK-3722 with proposed redirects and sample titles. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MARK-3722
Jules: Uploaded UTM matrix: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-utms-example
Leo: Uploaded keyword doc + SERP notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/2-keywords-bench-draft
Priya: Thanks team. If eng can confirm the nginx snippet and fix the preview 502, we can run the staging crawl tomorrow morning and schedule the webinar landing promotion. Ping here for blockers.
